newsitem.title: USA: Jefferson reallocates loan loss allowance.
newsitem.headline: Jefferson reallocates loan loss allowance.

text.p: Jefferson Savings Bancorp Inc said Friday it has reallocated $2.6 million of its allowance for loan losses from Jefferson Savings and Loan Association FA to First Federal Savings Bank of North Texas retroactive to December 31, 1996.

The company said the reallocation has no effect on its consolidated fiscal statements as of December 31, 1996, nor on its statements as of March 31, 1997. It said there is also no effect on its overall allowance for loan losses.
It said the reallocation is not the result of an increase in nonperforming loans or other assets, but reflects a shift in which the majority of its new lending is in the North Texas market.
